title: The AI Boom Is Expanding Beyond Chips. These 3 ETFs Could Be the Next Winners
excerpt: Chipmakers grabbed the spotlight during AI's first wave, but the real money in the next phase may flow somewhere most investors are not looking yet. Three ET...
content_html:
Quick Read

  • CIBR leads with a 22% year-to-date return, while SKYY's cloud holdings capture AI's shift from model training to enterprise deployment.

  • AI is expanding both the volume and sophistication of cyber threats, making cybersecurity a top enterprise spending priority across industries.

  • Despite a 17% year-to-date drop, IGV's 279% three-year total return signals software's enduring role monetizing AI through enterprise productivity platforms.

  • Don't wait: the analyst who called NVIDIA in 2010 just revealed his top 10 AI stocks. See the full list FREE now.

Artificial intelligence has fueled one of the strongest stock market rallies in recent years, with semiconductor companies leading much of the market's gains in 2026. While chipmakers remain central to the AI ecosystem, the next phase of growth could be driven by the cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, and software companies that enable businesses to put AI to work.

For investors looking beyond chipmakers, the First Trust Cloud Computing ETF (NASDAQ:SKYY), First Trust Nasdaq Cybersecurity ETF (NASDAQ:CIBR), and iShares Expanded Tech-Software Sector ETF (BATS:IGV) each provide exposure to a different area of the expanding AI landscape. As enterprise adoption begins to accelerate, these three ETFs could be well positioned to benefit.

Businesses Are Putting AI to Work

The first phase of the AI boom has been driven largely by the companies developing the hardware needed to train AI models. While semiconductors remain essential, the next stage of growth is likely to come from businesses across industries incorporating AI into their day-to-day operations.

Instead of simply building larger AI models, companies are increasingly investing in the cloud infrastructure needed to deploy AI applications, the cybersecurity solutions required to protect AI-powered systems, and the software platforms that enable employees to automate tasks and improve productivity.

As AI adoption continues to grow, spending is likely to broaden across all areas of the technology sector.

Don't wait: the analyst who called NVIDIA in 2010 just revealed his top 10 AI stocks. See the full list FREE now.

For investors, that shift could create opportunities beyond just semiconductor stocks. ETFs that are focused on cloud computing, cybersecurity, and enterprise software seem well positioned to benefit as artificial intelligence becomes an increasingly important part of the broader economy.

First Trust Cloud Computing ETF (SKYY)

As AI moves from development to widespread deployment, cloud computing is likely to play an increasingly important role. Currently, most businesses lack the infrastructure to run AI applications on their own. This makes cloud platforms the primary way organizations access the computing power needed to integrate AI into everyday operations.

人工智能推动了近年来最强劲的股市反弹之一，其中半导体公司将引领 2026 年市场的大部分涨幅。 虽然芯片制造商仍然是人工智能生态系统的核心，但下一阶段的增长可能由云基础设施、网络安全和软件公司推动，这些公司使企业能够将人工智能投入使用。

对于芯片制造商以外的投资者来说，First Trust 云计算 ETF (NASDAQ:SKYY)、First Trust Nasdaq Cyber​​security ETF (NASDAQ:CIBR) 和 iShares Expanded Tech-Software Sector ETF (BATS:IGV) 各自提供了对不断扩大的人工智能领域的不同领域的投资。 随着企业采用率开始加速，这三只 ETF 可能会受益匪浅。

企业正在将人工智能运用到工作中

人工智能热潮的第一阶段主要是由开发训练人工智能模型所需硬件的公司推动的。 尽管半导体仍然至关重要，但下一阶段的增长可能来自于将人工智能纳入日常运营的各行业企业。

公司不再简单地构建更大的人工智能模型，而是越来越多地投资于部署人工智能应用程序所需的云基础设施、保护人工智能驱动的系统所需的网络安全解决方案以及使员工能够自动化任务并提高生产力的软件平台。

随着人工智能应用的不断增长，支出可能会扩大到技术领域的所有领域。

不要等待：2010 年给 NVIDIA 打电话的分析师刚刚透露了他最喜欢的 10 只人工智能股票。 立即免费查看完整列表。

对于投资者来说，这种转变可能会创造不仅仅是半导体股票的机会。 随着人工智能成为更广泛经济中日益重要的一部分，专注于云计算、网络安全和企业软件的 ETF 似乎处于有利地位。

第一信托云计算ETF (SKYY)

随着人工智能从开发走向广泛部署，云计算可能会发挥越来越重要的作用。 目前，大多数企业缺乏自行运行人工智能应用程序的基础设施。 这使得云平台成为组织获取将人工智能集成到日常运营中所需计算能力的主要方式。
